title: Lemon oregano pork
summary: Lemon oregano pork is a mediterranean dinner built around pork fillet and lemon juice, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat pork fillet dry and season it. Prep lemon juice and dried oregano for Lemon oregano pork so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook pork fillet on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook lemon juice and dried oregano in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Lemon oregano pork before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice pork fillet and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
